value.rationale: Exact finite-rank logical spectra on single successor cycles quantify the sharp distinguishability boundary of a canonical finite model family. The first five thresholds (2,4,7,11,19), particularly the 19-length rank-five cutoff compared with the generic 32-length EF tail guarantee, give a complete natural cutoff useful for finite-model benchmarks and comparing locality bounds; this is not an arbitrary unmotivated subfamily or a mere restatement of the classical EF criterion.
